speaker: Doctor
text: I see you recently had acute sinusitis treated with antibiotics, and now you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever. Were your sinusitis symptoms recurrent or did they persist despite the antibiotic treatment?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That suggests the infection may have spread from the sinuses. Is the flank pain sharp and localized to one side, or does it radiate toward your groin?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Eosinophilic Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (Churg-Strauss Syndrome) presenting with renal involvement.

The presence of binucleated eosinophilic cells in the urine and the history of sinusitis followed by flank pain and fever strongly suggest a vasculitic process rather than a simple bacterial infection. We need to confirm this with blood work showing eosinophilia and ANCA titers.
